_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: LearniqSettings: the admin-only segment (po/vo/mbo/he/corporate) setting. Does not gate any other menu's visibility yet; see openspec/changes/segment-feature-flags/.

pages.title: App settings
pages._note: LearniqSettings is a flat, un-lifecycled singleton (segment, setBy, setAt) mirroring SovereigntyPolicy's own singleton shape — an admin-configuration archetype, not a document or a correspondence record (HARD RULE 1: no email/calendar/files leaves). Body is a single Data widget; no Related panel (nothing else references this record yet). Sidebar keeps metadata + audit-trail. Setting segment here does not yet change which menus render for anyone: menu gating on this value is a follow-up code change (see openspec/changes/segment-feature-flags/design.md).
